title: Joint or Per-Option? Compact Encoders for Closed-Set Decisions from 17 Million to 1 Billion Parameters
abstract: arXiv:2610.30970v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many language-model pipelines end in a closed-set decision, such as selecting a tool. Prompting a large language model for it is slow and order-sensitive. We ask how small an encoder for such decisions can be and whether it should read the options jointly or separately. In a three-seed study at 32 million parameters, per-option scoring beats joint scoring on a held-out sample of a 37-benchmark decision suite by 5.8 points of chance-corrected skill at matched optimizer steps and by 2.8 at approximately matched training compute; two external benchmarks agree, though not significantly on their unseen tasks. Crossing reader with initialisation shows that the advantage requires a reranker initialisation, whose query-candidate pair input matches per-option reading; from the raw encoder the two readers are indistinguishable. translated_title: 联合还是逐选项？面向闭集决策的紧凑编码器：参数规模从1700万到10亿
translated_abstract: 许多语言模型流水线最终都要做一个闭集决策，例如选择某个工具。为此对大型语言模型进行提示既缓慢又对顺序敏感。我们探讨用于此类决策的编码器可以小到什么程度，以及它应该联合读取所有选项还是分别读取每个选项。在一项3200万参数、三个随机种子的研究中，在匹配优化器步数的条件下，逐选项评分在包含37个基准的决策套件的保留样本上，比联合评分高出5.8个点的机会校正技能分数；在近似匹配训练计算量的条件下高出2.8个点；两个外部基准的结果方向一致，但在其未见任务上差异不显著。将读取方式与初始化方式进行交叉实验表明，这一优势依赖于重排序器初始化，因为其查询-候选对输入方式与逐选项读取相匹配；而若从原始编码器出发，两种读取方式则难以区分。逐选项评分需要5到13倍的编码器前向传递次数：中位延迟至多增加一倍，但……
tldr: 在闭集决策任务上，采用重排序器初始化的逐选项评分小型编码器（1700万至10亿参数）在精度上超越了联合评分和大语言模型提示，而延迟至多只增加一倍。
en_tdlr: Compact per-option encoders with reranker initialisation outperform joint scoring and LLM prompting on closed-set decisions across 17M to 1B parameters, with at most double the median latency.
